text: This report recommends an amendment to Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s By-law No. 1-2022, reintroducing the authority to borrow.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the proposed new content to be inserted into Amended By-law No. 1-2022 with the subsequent sections re-numbered accordingly, as presented in Revised Attachment 1 to the report (November 6, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund. 2. Presented the amended By-law No. 1-2022 to the Members of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund for their confirmation.
